events: first contact on result.first_transverse_bar.name with any individual normal_N > 1, regardless robot kind
first total <=1N run start and its first 20ms confirmation
first total >1N landing after qualified air
guide aggregate >1N first, peak and last, count and contiguous episodes
air_definition: All logged environment positive normals summed before threshold; <=1N for >=40 consecutive 0.5ms stages; retain original labels and verify not regrade scores
guide_definition: row.guide_normal_N > 1, identical to actual runner result counter; separate positive contact identities and individual >1N contacts
same_stage: drivepoint.root_xyz_pre_m + private_contact_diagnostic.root_rotation_world_from_body33_pre and stage_time_s. Root POST kept separate. Pitch = atan2(-R20,hypot(R00,R10)). No interpolation.
control_join: physics sample_index //20 to actual current control interval; verify command_time <= stage < time_s. Retain event-adjacent previous/current/next control summaries only, deduplicated by index.
control_fields: landing_transition_weight (same schedule for K/ff/eq by frozen source)
last 0.5ms stage bounded ctrl in that control interval
unknowns: 2k actual active joint q4: not logged, do not integrate dq or decode biased/delayed encoder as truth
finite_and_schema: Reject explicit nonfinite/schema/stage mismatch; preserve completed event prefix/diagnostic and do not manufacture zero or rescan to repair
source_scope: Only selected small config/result/manifest/protocol and actually necessary code SHA. No model/279mesh reads/hash, raw archival hashes, other TRAIN/heldout/H5 reads, project imports, physics, compilation, QA, gain fitting, controller modification or agent
output_scope: Small event JSON, <=80 line report, receipt. No dense extracted windows and no self-imposed byte-cap/rescan loop.
qualification: Descriptive observations only; retain both original failures and guide33/guide3; PH7_pending, outside current PH6 cutoff
